# m.stocks.filings.risk_factors

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Risk factors disclosed in company filings, classified by category, one row each.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.stocks.filings.risk_factors(symbols=None, *, start=None, end=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.APPEND`, which appends each row it hasn't seen, identified by `Cik`, `FilingDate`, `PrimaryCategory`, `SecondaryCategory`, `TertiaryCategory` and `SupportingText`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`symbols`](README.md#symbols) | Stock tickers; None, the default, for every filer. |
| [`start`](README.md#start) | The first filing date. |
| [`end`](README.md#end) | The last filing date. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | The field to sort by, such as `"filing_date"`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | The direction of `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Further endpoint parameters, such as `{"cik": "0000320193"}`. Keys: `cik`, `cik_any_of`, `cik_gt`, `cik_gte`, `cik_lt`, `cik_lte`, `ticker_gt`, `ticker_gte`, `ticker_lt`, `ticker_lte`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Risk Factors (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Stocks Basic | Updated daily |
| Stocks Starter | Updated daily |
| Stocks Developer | Updated daily |
| Stocks Advanced | Updated daily |
| Stocks Business | Updated daily |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "Stock ticker symbol for the company." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `Cik` | String | SEC Central Index Key (10 digits, zero-padded). |
| `FilingDate` | String | Date when the filing was submitted to the SEC (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD). |
| `PrimaryCategory` | String | Top-level risk category |
| `SecondaryCategory` | String | Mid-level risk category |
| `SupportingText` | String | Snippet of text to support the given label |
| `TertiaryCategory` | String | Most specific risk classification |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
